reuse.why: Correctly extends the existing shouldFillCategory policy, but parses the tag with its own regex instead of the existing extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: The same notes LEFT JOIN and group_notes column are added to both getBudgetData and getFillCategories, and isFixedGroup re-implements tag parsing that shared/tags already provides.

placement.why: The #fixed exclusion is a new condition in shouldFillCategory, the predicate every month-wide action already goes through.

scope.why: Only the policy, its two data queries, one test and a release note are changed.

maintainability.why: The rule lives in one predicate, but a private tag regex can disagree with how the app recognises tags elsewhere, and the data feed must be kept in sync in two queries.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts isFixedGroup uses its own /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/ regex rather than extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroup reshapes shared/tags tag extraction as a one-off regex with slightly different boundary rules.

one_place.where: The rule is decided once in shouldFillCategory (via isFixedGroup), used by copyPreviousMonth and every getFillCategories action; only the group_notes data is fetched in two queries.
